text:
lina: Heads-up — experiment idea: instead of uniform sampling at SDK level, make sampling route-prioritized so heavy-cost endpoints are oversampled for quota/cost dashboards. Want to run a weekend canary.
arjun: can you clarify the API/contract change? header-only or body?
lina: header-only. we add a short negotiation header + sampling hint. server will accept either but prefer route-aware when offered. sample headers:

```http
X-RW-Sample-Version: 2
X-Redwood-Sample-Hint: route=paid-inference;mode=prefer
```

paula: big fan for visibility on expensive routes. main worry: console will show a sudden jump in per-route sample rate which could look like traffic change to PMs. we need a normalization view.

ben: agreed. we should emit both raw-sampled and normalized metrics during canary (at least 10 days). telemetry team can run a parity check job.

telemetry-bot: FYI: past header-casing issue tracked in incident-1822, ensure tests for python-requests and go-http header preservation.
lina: noted. will add matrix tests.
arjun: SDK release plan? minor vs patch? this feels breaking for metrics consumers.
lina: opt-in minor for all SDKs; env var REDWOOD_ROUTE_SAMPLING=route-aware to enable. default stays uniform. we only flip default in next major after parity window.

paula: add explicit startup log when env var is set so customers see they opted in (and can disable it via REDWOOD_ROUTE_SAMPLING=off).

ben: console changes: add toggle per-tenant to surface "sampling mode" and a button to show raw vs normalized charts. QA should run on the canary tenant before wider rollout.

lina: propose rollout steps:
1) create server-side acceptance (v1 + v2 headers)
2) SDK opt-in minor across py/ts/go with handshake header
3) console feature flag + canary tenant toggle
4) telemetry nightly parity job emitting both metrics for 14 days
5) review then decide default in major release

arjun: for SDKs please keep header name stable but add versioning so proxies can fallback: X-RW-Sample-Version: 2. good to add a small grace period where server logs both headers.

paula: docs: we need a migration note and a short FAQ for "why charts changed". include example queries to compare pre/post buckets.

lina: will open PR with opt-in env var + unit tests. target: draft PR before Friday deploy window.

release-bot: release checklist created: repo=redwood/sdk-sampling, ticket=RW-8146.

ben: ops runbook owner? we should add quick KQL snippets and rollback env var steps. also include how to toggle tenant sampling from console.

paula: I'll own the runbook and a short support playbook for PM slack pings.

lina: tests required: integration across client matrix (py 3.9/3.11, node 18, go1.20), header-casing tests, and an end-to-end canary verifying both raw & normalized metrics land in the same time window.

arjun: can we add a non-invasive server mode that logs but doesn't change sampling decisions? good for dry-run checks.
lina: yes, server will support "hint-only" mode that records the incoming hint but doesn't alter sampling; telemetry parity job can use that.

telemetry-bot: note: create mapping job that outputs a join key to merge uniform samples with route-aware samples for historical continuity (14d retention).

lina: timeline: PR by Thu EOD, test matrix run Fri, canary Sat-Sun. if stable, extend to 5% tenants next week.

paula: +1. I'll draft the FAQ and the support playbook.

arjun: ping me when PR is ready for compatibility review. remember to include changelog entry and an opt-in example in each SDK readme.

lina: will do. thanks all.
